newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot market very slow at $72- USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot market very slow at $72- USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow in the Panhandle area early Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were steady in a light test. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers.
Sales reported on 100 slaughter steers and 300 heifers; following a weekly movement of 75,300 head.
Note - all cattle prices based on net weights FOB the feedlot after a 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1150-1250 lbs 72.00. Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 72.00. Select, few Choice 2-3 1050-1150 lbs 71.00. Confirmed - 400
